# Code Review and Validation Mechanisms — `sjarmak/scix-agent` @ `dd618037`

---

## 1. Repository-Wide Mechanisms

### 1.1 CI Workflow — `check`

**File:** [`.github/workflows/check.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/check.yml)

- Trigger: every push to any branch, every pull request.
- Infrastructure: `ubuntu-latest` + `pgvector/pgvector:pg16` service container, loaded from [`ci/scix_test_schema.sql`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/ci/scix_test_schema.sql). `SCIX_TEST_DSN` and `SCIX_DSN` both point at `scix_test`.
- Invokes `make check-ci BASE="origin/<base_ref>"`.
- Installs `.[dev,qdrant,graph,mcp]`; intentionally omits `torch`, `fastapi`, `umap` so the heavy/GPU-bound modules self-skip.

### 1.2 Makefile Targets

**File:** [`Makefile`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/Makefile)

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `lint` | `ruff check src/ scripts/ tests/` (all files) |
| `fmt-check` | `ruff check + black --check` (all files) |
| `lint-changed` | `ruff check` on files changed vs `BASE` only (incremental) |
| `fmt-check-changed` | `black --check` on files changed vs `BASE` only |
| `check-ci` | `lint-changed + fmt-check-changed + test` — the CI gate |
| `check` | `lint + fmt-check + test` — full local gate |

**Documented rationale (comment in Makefile, L15–18):** The tree carries pre-existing ruff/black debt; the CI gate is incremental. Full-tree compliance is the eventual target.

### 1.3 Pre-commit Hooks

**File:** [`.pre-commit-config.yaml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/.pre-commit-config.yaml)

Hooks (staged-files only, same incremental philosophy as CI):
- `ruff v0.15.8` with `--fix`
- `black 25.1.0`
- `pre-commit-hooks v5.0.0`: trailing whitespace, end-of-file fixer, YAML check, merge-conflict check
- `check-added-large-files --maxkb=10000` — corpus guard blocking accidental ADS JSONL commits

**Version pinning:** `pyproject.toml` dev extras pin `black==25.1.0` and `ruff==0.15.8` exactly, matching `.pre-commit-config.yaml` byte-for-byte. Comment at [pyproject.toml L22–24](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L22-L24) explains the reason: version drift causes `fmt-check` to fail on reformatting of the whole tree, not real debt.

### 1.4 Ruff / Black Configuration

**File:** [`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L90-L116)

- `line-length = 100` in both `[tool.black]` and `[tool.ruff]`.
- Ruff rules: `E, F, I, W`; `E501` suppressed (line-too-long owned by black).
- `scripts/*` and `tests/*` suppress `E402` (import-after-sys.path/guard patterns are intentional).
- Pytest `testpaths = ["tests"]`; `pythonpath = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]`.
- Markers: `integration` (requires live DB), `network` (outbound access), `unit` (fast/dependency-free).

### 1.5 Architecture Diagram CI

**File:** [`.github/workflows/likec4-pages.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/.github/workflows/likec4-pages.yml)

- Trigger: push to `main` touching `architecture/**`.
- Step "Check model source links resolve (drift guard)": runs `node architecture/site/check-links.mjs` before diagram export. Fails CI if the LikeC4 model has dangling source links.
- Publishes rendered diagrams to GitHub Pages.

### 1.6 Optional-Dependency Module Gating (`conftest.py`)

**File:** [`tests/conftest.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/conftest.py)

`collect_ignore` is populated at collection time for modules requiring absent optional dependencies (`fastapi`, `defusedxml`, `qdrant_client`, `pgvector`, `igraph`, `torch`, `leidenalg`). Emits a `warnings.warn` per skipped group. Tracked as `scix_experiments-o835`.

### 1.7 Production-DSN Guard

**File:** [`tests/helpers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/helpers.py)

`is_production_dsn()` re-exports `scix.db.is_production_dsn`. `get_test_dsn()` returns `None` if `SCIX_TEST_DSN` is unset or points at production. Destructive tests call `get_test_dsn()` and skip if it returns `None`. Comment at L13–17 notes a historical bypass bug (URI-form DSN not detected) fixed 2026-04-13 by unifying to the library implementation.

---

## 2. Specific Validation Mechanisms (Change-Tied)

### 2.1 MCP Contract Conformance — `test_mcp_contract_conformance.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_mcp_contract_conformance.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_mcp_contract_conformance.py)

Two-step gate for the published MCP contract artifact `contract/scix_mcp_v1.json`:

1. **Surface conformance** (bead `scix_experiments-x2dp`):
   - Visible tool count ≤ `VISIBLE_TOOL_CAP` (15); no duplicate tool names.
   - Every tool has a valid `inputSchema` of `type: object` with `properties`.
   - Every error-envelope dict literal in server source carries `"error_code"` alongside `"error"` (AST scan via `ast.walk`). Triggered by a 2026-06-15 audit finding 30/77 error returns missing `error_code`.
   - Error code list in contract matches `CATALOG` from `scix.mcp_errors` exactly.

2. **Artifact drift gate**:
   - `contract/scix_mcp_v1.json` must match `mcp_contract.build_contract()` at run time. Divergence fails CI until `python scripts/gen_mcp_contract.py` is re-run. Breaking changes require bumping `CONTRACT_VERSION`.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_mcp_contract_conformance.py`

### 2.2 MCP Error Envelope Convention — `test_mcp_error_envelopes.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_mcp_error_envelopes.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_mcp_error_envelopes.py)

- Pin the structured-error `{"error": str, "error_code": str}` shape per tool and per error case.
- `test_every_emitted_error_code_is_in_the_closed_catalog`: regex-scans server + `mcp_handlers/` for `ErrorCode.NAME` references and raw `"error_code": "..."` literals; both must be in `CATALOG`. Introduced by bead `scix_experiments-ir2h`.
- `test_documented_error_codes_in_audit_doc`: asserts every asserted code appears backtick-quoted in `docs/mcp_tool_audit_2026-04.md`.
- Covers: `unscoped_broad_query`, `entity_legacy_extraction_type`, `invalid_action`, `invalid_limit`, `invalid_mode`, `invalid_direction`, `invalid_method`, `invalid_filters`, `invalid_scope`, `missing_required_params`.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_mcp_error_envelopes.py`

### 2.3 Unscoped Query Guard — `test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py)

Bead `scix_experiments-uerc`. Guards the search tool heuristic (`_is_unscoped_broad_query`):
- Parametrized unit tests covering token count, string length (≥30 chars), filter scoping (year, arxiv_class, entity_types), bypass flag, empty/whitespace edge cases.
- End-to-end tests asserting the guard fires **before** `hybrid_search`, `lexical_search`, or the disambiguator.
- Telemetry convention pinning (bead `scix_experiments-3qun`): lifted structured-error logs `success=True, error_msg="unscoped_broad_query"`; unlifted structured errors log `success=True, error_msg=NULL`. Documents the dashboard blind spot and pins it explicitly so a silent semantics flip breaks tests.
- Schema tests: `bypass_unscoped_guard` field must exist in `search` tool `inputSchema` with `type: boolean, default: false`.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py`

### 2.4 AST Lint for `document_entities` Writes — `test_ast_lint_resolver.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_ast_lint_resolver.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_ast_lint_resolver.py)

Tests the `scripts/ast_lint_resolver.py` tool that enforces write-access rules for `document_entities`, `document_entities_jit_cache`, and `document_entities_canonical` tables:
- `test_current_src_has_no_violations`: runs lint against the live `src/` tree; any violation fails.
- Tests that planted `INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` patterns are caught.
- Tests that `# resolver-lint: bypass` exempts a site.
- Tests that `resolve_entities.py` itself is exempt.
- Tests word-boundary rule for `document_entities_canonical` not tripping the base-table regex.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_ast_lint_resolver.py`

### 2.5 ADR-006 Guard (LaTeX Body Provenance) — `test_body_adr006_guard.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_body_adr006_guard.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_body_adr006_guard.py)

Pure unit tests (no DB, no network) via mocked `psycopg` cursors:
- `_check_body_latex_provenance`: returns `None` for absent rows, `ads_body`, `s2orc`, `docling`, `abstract`; returns source string for `ar5iv` and `arxiv_local`.
- Handles `UndefinedTable` exception (migration 041 not yet applied) via rollback without crashing.
- `read_paper_section` and `search_within_paper`: budget enforcement applied only for LaTeX-derived sources; metadata key `adr006_guarded` present iff guard fired.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_body_adr006_guard.py`

### 2.6 Qdrant Client Contract — `test_qdrant_contract.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_qdrant_contract.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_qdrant_contract.py)

PRD MH-16, bead `5jtf`. Uses in-process `:memory:` client (no server):
- `test_version_is_pinned`: asserts `qdrant-client==1.17.1` exactly. Fails on any bump.
- Cosine score semantics, score ordering, `SearchParams.exact`, scroll cursor pagination.
- Documented bump procedure: re-run file against candidate version, update `PINNED_VERSION` and `pyproject.toml` pin in the same commit.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_qdrant_contract.py`

### 2.7 Migration Integrity — `test_migration_runner.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_migration_runner.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_migration_runner.py)

- `test_no_duplicate_version_numbers`: scans `migrations/*.sql` for duplicate numeric prefixes.
- `test_all_migrations_contiguous`: asserts no gaps in the version sequence up to `max_version`.
- `test_013_collision_resolved`: asserts old `013_query_log.sql` no longer exists, `013_entity_dictionary.sql` does. Named collision; the fix is encoded as a deterministic test.
- `test_migration_019_exists` and `TestMigration019Content`: asserts structural SQL elements of the `schema_migrations` migration.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_migration_runner.py`

### 2.8 Migration Audit — `test_audit_schema_migrations.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_audit_schema_migrations.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_audit_schema_migrations.py)

Tests `scripts/audit_schema_migrations.py`, which parses migration files, probes the DB for effects, and joins against `schema_migrations`. Covers:
- Parsing (version extraction, filename, auto-probe for `CREATE TABLE/VIEW`).
- Block comment stripping (regression: `/* CREATE TABLE foo */` in comments must not be captured).
- Line comment stripping (regression: `-- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS,` trailing comma causing `IF` to be captured as table name).
- Status classification: `OK`, `MISSING_ROW`, `MISSING_EFFECTS`, `FILENAME_MISMATCH`, `UNKNOWN`, `PROBE_ERROR` (dedicated status to avoid `PROBE_ERROR` masking as `MISSING_EFFECTS`).
- Marker probe SQL injection guard via `_MARKER_SHAPE_RE` regex (rejects semicolons, `DROP` inside WHERE).
- Live DB probes gated on `SCIX_TEST_DSN`.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_audit_schema_migrations.py`

### 2.9 LLM Cost Ceiling — `test_llm_cost_ceiling.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_llm_cost_ceiling.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_llm_cost_ceiling.py)

- Requires `SCIX_TEST_DSN` (non-production); skips on production DSN.
- Tests per-query cap, daily cap, overflow blocking, reserve-then-adjust (`record_actual`), and negative-token/negative-cost raises.

**Verification query:** `SCIX_TEST_DSN=... pytest tests/test_llm_cost_ceiling.py`

### 2.10 Hypothesis Property Test — `test_resolve_entities_invariant.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_resolve_entities_invariant.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_resolve_entities_invariant.py)

- M13 acceptance criterion 5: all four resolution lanes (`static`, `jit`, `live_jit`, `local_ner`) must return identical entity-id sets for the same `(bibcode, candidate_set_hash, model_version)` triple.
- Uses `hypothesis` with `max_examples=120`. Confidence drift across lanes per entity ≤ 0.01.
- Uses `zlib.crc32` (not `hash()`) for stable cross-process seeding.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_resolve_entities_invariant.py`

### 2.11 Circuit Breaker FSM — `test_circuit_breaker.py`

**File:** [`tests/test_circuit_breaker.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/tests/test_circuit_breaker.py)

PRD §M10. Pure unit tests with a fake monotonic clock injected via constructor. Covers all three FSM states (`CLOSED`, `OPEN`, `HALF_OPEN`), trip counter persistence across cycles, budget enforcement at/above limit, zero-budget immediate trip.

**Verification query:** `pytest tests/test_circuit_breaker.py`

---

## 3. Operator / AGENTS.md Rules That Back-Reference Tests

The [`AGENTS.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-scix-agent@dd618037f61035bd62f1e7a620029c6b4867ab6a/-/blob/AGENTS.md) encodes several rules directly connected to test-enforced invariants:

| Rule | Backing test |
|---|---|
| `WHERE success=FALSE OR error_msg IS NOT NULL` for query_log | `test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py` (telemetry convention tests) |
| Never exceed 15-tool MCP cap | `test_mcp_contract_conformance.py::test_visible_surface_within_cap` |
| Re-run `gen_mcp_contract.py` after tool surface change | `test_mcp_contract_conformance.py::test_published_contract_matches_live` |
| `qdrant-client` bump requires re-run of contract tests | `test_qdrant_contract.py::test_version_is_pinned` |
| No `pytest tests/` without `SCIX_TEST_DSN` | `helpers.py::get_test_dsn()` + per-test `skipif` guards |

---

## 4. Deterministic Verification Queries

```bash
# Full CI gate (lint changed + fmt-check changed + tests, markers deselected)
make check-ci BASE="origin/main"

# Full local gate (lint + fmt-check + test, all markers)
make check

# MCP contract surface + artifact drift
pytest tests/test_mcp_contract_conformance.py -v

# MCP error envelope closed-catalog scan
pytest tests/test_mcp_error_envelopes.py -v

# Unscoped query guard heuristic + telemetry convention
pytest tests/test_mcp_search_unscoped_guard.py -v

# AST lint — document_entities write-access rules
pytest tests/test_ast_lint_resolver.py -v

# Qdrant client contract (in-process :memory:, no server)
pytest tests/test_qdrant_contract.py -v

# Migration integrity (no DB)
pytest tests/test_migration_runner.py -v

# Migration audit parser + status classification (no DB)
pytest tests/test_audit_schema_migrations.py -k "not TestProbeDB" -v

# Migration audit live DB probes
SCIX_TEST_DSN="..." pytest tests/test_audit_schema_migrations.py::TestProbeDB -v

# ADR-006 guard (no DB, no network)
pytest tests/test_body_adr006_guard.py -v

# M13 cross-lane set equality (Hypothesis, 120 examples)
pytest tests/test_resolve_entities_invariant.py -v

# Circuit breaker FSM (no DB)
pytest tests/test_circuit_breaker.py -v

# LLM cost ceiling (requires non-production SCIX_TEST_DSN)
SCIX_TEST_DSN="..." pytest tests/test_llm_cost_ceiling.py -v

# Architecture link drift guard (no Python env needed)
node architecture/site/check-links.mjs
```

Two-step gate for the published MCP contract artifact `contract/scix_mcp_v1.json`:

1. **Surface conformance** (bead `scix_experiments-x2dp`):
   - Visible tool count ≤ `VISIBLE_TOOL_CAP` (15); no duplicate tool names.

   - Error code list in contract matches `CATALOG` from `scix.mcp_errors` exactly.

2. **Artifact drift gate**:
   - `contract/scix_mcp_v1.json` must match `mcp_contract.build_contract()` at run time. Divergence fails CI until `python scripts/gen_mcp_contract.py` is re-run. Breaking changes require bumping `CONTRACT_VERSION`.
